messages:
alex (AE): Quick question — Greenfield Labs wants a paid 6-week POC but insists on Net-60 and a 3-way split invoice (POC, ramp, production). Can deal desk/finance/legal weigh in? They say total first-year spend ~ $120k if we convert.
raj (SE): POC spec: 2 dedicated seats, ~4xA100 equiv, expected monthly ~150M tokens. We can cap usage for the POC and add alerting.
alex (AE): Customer legal contact is marie@greenfield.com. They will provide a PO. They want invoices at kickoff, 90 days, and on go-live. POC is paid (they pay the first invoice). Asking for approval to accept Net-60 + split invoicing.
tess (Deal Desk): Need ARR, contract length, whether the POC is refundable, and the exact invoice amounts. Split invoicing + Net-60 is non-standard for a small multi-year commit. Share PO and legal contact.
alex (AE): Numbers: POC $18,000, Ramp $42,000, Production commit $60,000 (total $120k). Contract: 12mo post-conversion standard Redwood T&Cs.
sam (Finance): Two things: 1) Net-60 requires a credit check (we normally accept Net-30). 2) For split invoicing we need GL mapping + revenue recognition milestones. Recommend 30% partial upfront for POC to reduce cash risk. If customer provides PO and trade refs we can be flexible.
jo (Legal): If Finance can accept Net-60 we need to add payment-default language, late fee, and an SOW appendix mapping milestones to invoices. Also confirm signatory name and jurisdiction. I can draft the SOW addendum.
alex (AE): Signatory will be CTO Marie L. (marie@greenfield.com). Jurisdiction: CA. They want all invoices Net-60.
raj (SE): For the POC I'll create a quota cap and rate limits so we don't have unexpected overages. I'll add a note in the SOW about token caps and monitoring.
tess (Deal Desk): Deal Desk can provisionally approve split invoicing + Net-60 if: 1) Finance signs off on credit check, 2) Legal adds SOW milestones, 3) Customer provides PO + 2 trade refs, AND we get bank payment details or ACH mandate. Alternative: accept Net-60 only with a 30% escrow held until first invoice clears. Anyone object? :thinking_face: 
sam (Finance): I'll run the credit check today. If it's green we can accept Net-60 with a 30% reserve held until first invoice clears. Also need billing contact and GL code — alex please DM.
jo (Legal): Uploaded redline to the contract repo: https://redwood/legal/greenfield/redline-v1. Added payment schedule clause and 1.5%/mo late interest. Also added SOW milestone language.
ops-bot: Billing ticket created: #BILL-4821 — credit-check form + PO intake: https://redwood/billing/BILL-4821
tess (Deal Desk): Approve in principle pending Sam's credit result and Jo's final SOW language. @sam please confirm by EOD so AE can start next-week kickoff.
sam (Finance): Credit check complete — profile: acceptable. Bank ACH on file. Finance approves Net-60 with the 30% reserve condition. I'll push onboarding invoice template to the billing ticket.
jo (Legal): Everything looks clean from Legal. Redline accepted. No unusual indemnities or data terms.
alex (AE): Thanks team — I'll tell the customer we have conditional approval, ask for the PO + ACH info and signatory. Proceeding to schedule POC kickoff for next Monday. :tada:
tess (Deal Desk): Noted — label the contract "split-invoice-net60-approved" and include in monthly risk log. Thanks all.
